# Repo-owned cpplint source snapshot

This is the pinned [cpplint/cpplint](https://github.com/cpplint/cpplint) source at commit `45102d1497f3688c7c1eceffb7b87e1fdcce49f3`, previously a Git submodule of Enroth Continuum. The original 64 tracked files are retained without source edits. The full upstream `LICENSE` remains here; the bundled Boost sample retains its own `samples/boost-sample/LICENSE`, source headers and license references. This file is Enroth Continuum provenance metadata, not part of the upstream snapshot.

cpplint is an optional style tool. Owning this source removes its submodule fetch, but does not resolve the other MM7 build inputs or make a clean offline build possible.
